Loops6 nominal size/scale conditions and8 cart states with fake GET menu/tax. Real CartPanelVM populated with empty/small60line/highquantity/discount/comp/split variants. Captures PNG only3 states, records capture errors separately, writes results/error then closes. Scaling adjusts DIP geometry and capture raster but does not change OS DPI. Does not test delivery row, busy/pending or theme states.
